Built for creators who need to own their stack, not rent it. Originating in Zimbabwe, this system is pressure-tested against currency collapse, payment rejection, and financial isolation. It’s not a hack—it’s base-layer infrastructure designed to operate where conventional platforms fail.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Solana payment

This is a sovereign commerce stack—a complete combination of tools that let you sell digital products without relying on Stripe, PayPal, or any third-party platform. It uses Solana for payments because it’s fast, cheap, and doesn’t require KYC. The stack automates product delivery the moment payment confirms on-chain. You own the entire system: hosting, backend logic, order storage, and file delivery. No platform can shut you down. No fees beyond Solana’s transaction costs (under $0.10 per payment). This isn’t a temporary fix—it’s permanent infrastructure. Designed for creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software. If you’ve been locked out of global payment systems, this is how you reclaim control.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The stack uses GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting—both are free and globally distributed. Backend logic runs on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, depending on your needs. Orders are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets, and product files are delivered via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Payments are processed through NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies and charges a flat 0.5% fee. When a buyer pays, NOWPayments verifies the transaction on-chain and triggers a webhook. The backend script checks the payment, logs the order, and sends the product download link automatically. Everything is configured to work without manual intervention. The system is stateless—no databases to manage, no servers to maintain. It’s designed to scale with your business, not break under pressure.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is built for digital creators in regions where Stripe, PayPal, and other platforms are unavailable or unreliable. If you’re in Kenya, Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, Bangladesh, or Venezuela, this stack is for you. It’s for creators selling digital products that require instant delivery: ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software. If you’ve ever had a payment rejected or a platform shut down your account, you know the pain this solves. It’s not just about selling—it’s about owning your commerce infrastructure. No subscriptions. No platform fees. No reliance on systems that don’t serve you. This is for creators who want to build on their own terms.
Solana transactions cost under $0.10—ideal for small digital product sales.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The stack is modular but integrated. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host your storefront—static, fast, and free. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic, from payment verification to file delivery. Supabase or Google Sheets store order data securely. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 serve product files directly to buyers. NOWPayments handles crypto payments, converting prices to USD at transaction time. Solana is the recommended network for its low fees and speed. Each component is chosen for reliability, cost, and ease of use. The system is open-source—you can inspect, modify, and deploy it yourself. No black boxes. No hidden dependencies. Full transparency, full control.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start with the Complete Builder Kit ($197) at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. It includes all blueprints, templates, and guides to deploy your stack in 48 hours. If you prefer to build from scratch, begin with hosting—set up GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, configure your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto processing and test the webhook flow. Store orders in Supabase or Google Sheets and host product files on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Test end-to-end: simulate a purchase, verify payment, and ensure file delivery works. Once deployed, you own it. No ongoing fees. No platform lock-in. Just sovereign commerce infrastructure that works where others fail.

Solana payments work for digital products because they’re fast, cheap, and don’t require KYC. The stack uses NOWPayments to verify transactions on-chain, triggering automatic product delivery via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. The entire system is hosted on free, globally distributed platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Orders are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets, and files are delivered from Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. This architecture ensures instant delivery, low fees, and full ownership—no platform dependencies.
You own the entire stack after deployment—no platform can shut you down.

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your hosting: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 2. Set up backend logic: Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 3. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto processing. 4. Configure order storage: Supabase or Google Sheets. 5. Host product files: Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 6. Test end-to-end: simulate a purchase, verify payment, and ensure file delivery. 7. Deploy and own your stack.
Frequently Asked Questions
Why Solana instead of other blockchains?
Solana is fast, with transaction fees under $0.10, making it ideal for small digital product purchases. It’s also widely supported by NOWPayments, ensuring seamless integration.
Can I use this if I’m not a developer?
Yes. The Complete Builder Kit includes step-by-step guides and templates. No coding required—just follow the instructions to deploy your stack.
What if I want to sell physical products?
This stack is designed for digital products with instant delivery. For physical goods, you’ll need to add shipping logic, which is not covered here.
How do I handle refunds?
Refunds are processed manually via your crypto wallet. The system logs all transactions, so you can verify purchases before issuing a refund.
Is this legal in my country?
The stack uses open-source tools and crypto payments, which are legal in most jurisdictions. Always consult local laws regarding cryptocurrency use.
